summary: A UI generator that emits real components for the Next.js world. Not a whole engineering department.
body: v0 is opinionated in a useful way: it speaks React, Tailwind, and shadcn-shaped interfaces, then hands you code. That is a different product from Lovable or Bolt, which try to be the app. If you already ship on Vercel, v0 shortens the blank-page problem. If you need a Python service, go to Cursor. Credits run out faster than the marketing site implies, so verify current paid seat pricing on v0’s page.
notes: Always paste the output into version control the same day
Design quality still needs a pass for accessibility
Pairs with Kiln’s own stack on purpose
